### When Wars Will Stop
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/when-wars-will-stop-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-7.html
Passage: Micah 4:3
Points:
- Human organizations like the League of Nations and the United Nations have consistently failed to eliminate global warfare.
- Micah looked beyond judgment and exile to an era of divine peace where nations beat weapons into farm implements and abandon war.
- Jesus clarified to His disciples that this comprehensive restoration belongs to His eternal, spiritual kingdom rather than an earthly political empire.
- While Christians cannot personally end all world conflicts, they are commanded by God's grace to pursue peace with others in daily life.

### The Exaltation of God's Mountain
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/exaltation-gods-mountain
Passage: Micah 4:1-5
Points:
- Beyond the threat of judgment and exile, Micah promised future restoration through the exaltation of the Lord's mountain above all hills.
- Ancient Near Eastern temples on mountains symbolized divine rule; elevating God's house over all indicates His total triumph over chaos and evil across creation.
- The prophecy portrays the unfolding of God's kingdom through the global worship and conversion of diverse nations streaming to Him.
- Believers are urged to pray for the arrival of this day, never considering anyone beyond redemption, and to support the spread of Christ's kingdom.
